What Is Laya? Laya vs Jev, with Live Demo!!

Laya is an open-source, non-autoregressive decision model: a 421M-parameter ModernBERT-large encoder with a typed decision head that answers choice, score and yes/no questions about a text in a single forward pass and returns calibrated probabilities instead of generated text.

The benchmark chart every section below refers back to.

Jev by TypeSafe AI is a closed decision-model API built around the same three question types. This article explains how decision models work, compares Laya and Jev on published benchmarks, latency, calibration and cost, and shows Laya running entirely in the browser with ONNX Runtime and no server behind it.

Every number below was read from the published model card, and the demo is a static page that anyone can open without an account, a key or a server.
